definitions.explanation: The sound a phone or app plays to signal an incoming notification. {通知|つうち} (notification) + {音|おん} (sound).

examples.japanese: {通知音|つうちおん}を{消|け}す。
メールの{通知音|つうちおん}が{鳴|な}った。
examples.english: The email notification sound went off.

examples.japanese: {会議中|かいぎちゅう}は{通知音|つうちおん}が{鳴|な}らないように{設定|せってい}する。
examples.english: I set it so that notification sounds don't play during meetings.

notes:
{通知|つうち} (notification) + {音|おん} (sound). Refers to the alert tone played by a phone or app.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通知音|つうちおん}を{消|け}す: to mute the notification sound
- {通知音|つうちおん}を{変|か}える: to change the notification tone
- {通知音|つうちおん}が{鳴|な}る: the notification sound plays
